subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should background session families be hidden by default across chat, dashboard, and tray surfaces when only the Sessions page offers a general visibility toggle?
rationale: The readable-title correction is bounded, but changing which existing sessions and counts users see is a product policy choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Keep filtering with recovery
options.body: Retain default background filtering, but confirm every affected surface has a clear route to the complete Sessions view and prove the active-background exception on Windows.

options.title: Separate naming from visibility
options.body: Land readable presentation metadata first and defer the default visibility change to a focused follow-up with dedicated UX review.

recommendation.title: Keep filtering with recovery
recommendation.body: Retain default background filtering, but confirm every affected surface has a clear route to the complete Sessions view and prove the active-background exception on Windows.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent companion-application refactoring work makes them the strongest available routing candidate for this cross-surface ownership and UX choice.
